description:
You are the Offshore Navigator and Watch Captain for a racing yacht competing in the Newport Bermuda Race (635 nautical miles, Newport RI to Bermuda). You must build a complete passage plan in Garmin BaseCamp: ten waypoints covering the rhumb-line route plus two emergency diversion ports, and two routes — a primary rhumb-line route and a weather-diversion alternate. Export everything as GPX for loading onto the yacht's chartplotter.

BaseCamp starts with an empty library (no prior data).

Create all 10 waypoints in My Collection with the exact names, coordinates (decimal degrees — positive=N, negative=W for western longitudes), symbols, and comments shown:

1. Name: BRENTON REEF WHISTLE  |  Lat: 41.4901  Lon: -71.3128  |  Symbol: Buoy, White  |  Comment: Race start area. Brenton Reef Lighted Whistle Buoy R2. Log departure time and course.
2. Name: NANTUCKET LS FLOAT  |  Lat: 41.2539  Lon: -69.9921  |  Symbol: Buoy, White  |  Comment: Clear Nantucket Lightship Float to N. Shoal water to S and E. Depth < 20m nearby.
3. Name: GEORGES BANK SE  |  Lat: 40.5000  Lon: -67.0000  |  Symbol: Waypoint  |  Comment: SE corner Georges Bank. Heavy fishing fleet area. Maintain AIS watch. ETA Day 1+.
4. Name: GULF STREAM ENTRY  |  Lat: 38.8000  Lon: -66.5000  |  Symbol: Danger  |  Comment: Gulf Stream entry. Update weather routing. Log time, COG, SOG, set, drift. Expect 2-4kt favorable.
5. Name: GULF STREAM EXIT  |  Lat: 36.5000  Lon: -65.8000  |  Symbol: Danger  |  Comment: Gulf Stream exit. Cross stream perpendicular. Call weather router on Iridium before crossing.
6. Name: BERMUDA APPROACH N  |  Lat: 33.2000  Lon: -64.9000  |  Symbol: Waypoint  |  Comment: N Bermuda approach. Reduce sail. Check NE Channel tides. Call Bermuda Radio Ch16.
7. Name: NORTH ROCK BUOY  |  Lat: 32.4985  Lon: -64.8024  |  Symbol: Buoy, White  |  Comment: North Rock Whistle Buoy. ID on chart. NE Channel entry. Slow to 6kts max.
8. Name: ST. DAVIDS HEAD FINISH  |  Lat: 32.3682  Lon: -64.6515  |  Symbol: Flag, Blue  |  Comment: Newport-Bermuda Race FINISH LINE. St. Davids Head Light. Radio finish to race committee.
9. Name: EMERGENCY - HALIFAX NS  |  Lat: 44.6476  Lon: -63.5752  |  Symbol: Medical Facility  |  Comment: Emergency diversion: Halifax, Nova Scotia. Customs: 1-888-502-9889. Marina VHF Ch68.
10. Name: EMERGENCY - AZORES  |  Lat: 37.7412  Lon: -25.6756  |  Symbol: Medical Facility  |  Comment: Emergency diversion: Ponta Delgada, Azores (Portugal). Clearance required. VHF Ch16.

Create these 2 routes, adding waypoints in the exact order listed:

Route 1 — Name: NEWPORT BERMUDA 2024 RHUMB  |  Waypoints in order: BRENTON REEF WHISTLE, NANTUCKET LS FLOAT, GEORGES BANK SE, GULF STREAM ENTRY, GULF STREAM EXIT, BERMUDA APPROACH N, NORTH ROCK BUOY, ST. DAVIDS HEAD FINISH
Route 2 — Name: NEWPORT BERMUDA 2024 WEATHER ALT  |  Waypoints in order: BRENTON REEF WHISTLE, NANTUCKET LS FLOAT, EMERGENCY - HALIFAX NS, GULF STREAM ENTRY, GULF STREAM EXIT, BERMUDA APPROACH N, NORTH ROCK BUOY, ST. DAVIDS HEAD FINISH

When done, export the entire My Collection as a GPX file and save it to C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\Newport_Bermuda_2024_PassagePlan.gpx
